lessons.title: Practice Trimming Replacing Text
lessons.description: Finish clean_and_censor(text, word, mask). Trim spaces from both ends, then replace word with mask. clean_and_censor(" bad words ", "bad", "***") equals "*** words". The test checks that clean_and_censor(" bad words ", "bad", "***") equals "*** words".
learning_objectives: Harbor bakers recount crates before dawn, and clean strings using strip and replace.

tests.name: test_clean_and_censor
tests.unittest_code:
def test_clean_and_censor(self):
    self.assertEqual(clean_and_censor("  bad words  ", "bad", "***"), "*** words")

lessons.solution_code:
def clean_and_censor(s, word, mask):
    return s.strip().replace(word, mask)
